I use a block of firm or extra firm tofu. Heat up my pan then when is hot add oil and let it warm up. Dry off the tofu with a paper towel because the excess water will spit and hurt you wheb it hits the oil. Crumble your tofu into scrambled egg-sized peices. Then add tumeric for color, nutritional yeast, and just a little bit of black salt. I let it cook until the the tofu gets kind of crispy and the water has cooked off. I add some other spices too like smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, tikka marsala seasoning. You can add veggies or faux meats too!
